Who We Are

Writing that works
for you

MyEzer exists for busy individuals and businesses who need organised, well-crafted paperwork. From a single CV to a full research proposal, we deliver writing that lasts.

Do you desire your space but need an executive assistant at your beck and call — to create a document, a Google Form for a planned event, or bring clarity to a situation with a call? MyEzer handles that.

"Creating and delivering long-lasting writing solutions that make a real difference."

Book a session

Sometimes your ideas are everywhere — brilliant, but tangled. You know what you want to say but can't find the words, the structure, or the time. That's exactly where MyEzer steps in.

Whether it's a document that needs organising, a Google Form for your next event, a proposal that needs shaping, or simply a call to talk through a situation and find clarity — MyEzer is your executive assistant, ready when you are.

📞Book a Session
🧩

Organise Your Thoughts

Have a flood of ideas but no structure? We listen, clarify, and translate your scattered vision into a clean, coherent document.

📋

Document Arrangement

From disorganised notes to polished paperwork — we take what you have and shape it into something professional and ready to use.

📊

Google Forms & Event Tools

Planning an event or survey? We set up your Google Forms, structure the questions, and get everything ready for your audience.

⚙️

Workflow Automation

We identify what in your process can be automated — form responses, email follow-ups, data collection, task assignments, scheduling, notifications, and more — and set it all up so your workflow runs itself.

🔁

Auto Follow-Ups & Notifications

Never chase a response manually again. We automate your follow-up emails, confirmation messages, reminders, and alerts so every form submission triggers the right action instantly.

📂

Data Sorting & Reporting

Form responses automatically sorted, filtered, and organised into spreadsheets or reports — saving you hours of manual data entry and letting you focus on what matters.

💬

Clarity Calls

Not sure how to approach a situation? Book a call with MyEzer and leave with a clear direction, a plan, and the confidence to act.
